We have a target molecule: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999. Need to propose route and output JSON.

We need to find templates to break bonds. The molecule has a sulfonamide linking two phenyl rings, and an amide attached to a phenyl with an aniline (NH2) on that phenyl? Actually structure: p-tolyl (CH3 on phenyl) attached to N-sulfonyl phenyl which is para-substituted with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline phenyl.

Simplify: target = p-tolyl-NHSO2-para-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline (para? Actually Nc3ccccc3N is an aniline (para? not specified). So we can think retrosynthesis: disconnection at amide bond (C=O-NH) to give acid (trans-α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline. Also disconnection at sulfonamide N-S bond to give sulfonyl chloride and aniline? Actually sulfonamide linking p-tolyl amine to sulfonyl phenyl. Could break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and amine.

Goal: 3 steps max. Could propose two disconnections: (1) amide formation from trans-α,β-unsaturated acid (cinnamic acid derivative) and aniline (3-aminophenyl). (2) sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride (p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride) and aniline (the same aniline? Actually the sulfonamide attaches to p-tolyl amine, not the same aniline). Wait structure: p-tolyl attached via N to sulfonyl group attached to phenyl which is attached to the unsaturated amide. So there are two nitrogens: one sulfonamide N attached to p-tolyl, and the amide N attached to aniline. So we need two separate amine components: p-toluidine (p-methyl aniline) and aniline (unsubstituted). The sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring (the central phenyl). So we need sulfonyl chloride derived from that phenyl sulfonyl (maybe 4-(trans-cinnamoylamino)phenyl sulfonyl chloride). Actually the sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl that also bears the unsaturated amide substituent. So we could form sulfonamide by reacting p-toluidine with sulfonyl chloride of that phenyl-sulfonyl (i.e., 4-(trans-cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride). That sulfonyl chloride could be made from the corresponding sulfonic acid (or from the phenyl sulfonyl chloride) via chlorination.

Thus route: Step1: Form amide: react trans-cinnamic acid (or 4-aminophenyl? Wait amide is between carbonyl and aniline attached to phenyl. The carbonyl attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N) meaning aniline attached to carbonyl (C=O) and the carbonyl attached to the trans-alkene attached to phenyl-sulfonyl. So the acid component is trans-4-(sulfonyl phenyl)cinnamic acid? Actually the unsaturated chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. So the acid is trans-4-(sulfonyl phenyl)cinnamic acid (i.e., 4-(phenylsulfonyl)cinnamic acid). The amine is aniline.

Thus step1: amide coupling of 4-(phenylsulfonyl)cinnamic acid with aniline to give the unsaturated amide attached to phenyl-sulfonyl phenyl.

Step2: sulfonamide formation: react p-toluidine with 4-(phenylsulfonyl)cinnamic acid? No, need sulfonyl chloride of phenyl-sulfonyl group. Actually after step1 we have product with sulfonyl phenyl attached to the unsaturated chain and amide attached to aniline. The sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring (the central phenyl). To attach p-tolyl via sulfonamide, we need to convert the sulfonyl phenyl to sulfonyl chloride then react with p-toluidine. But the sulfonyl phenyl is already part of the molecule; we need to form the N-S bond. So step2: sulfonyl chloride (4-(cinnamoylamido)phenylsulfonyl chloride) + p-toluidine -> target.

Thus we need to generate sulfonyl chloride precursor: 4-(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride. This can be made from 4-(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonic acid (or from 4-(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl fluoride) via chlorination (SO2Cl). Could also start from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride and do amide formation on the phenyl? But the amide is on the phenyl ring, not on the sulfonyl group. So we need to attach the unsaturated amide to the phenyl ring before sulfonyl chloride formation.

Thus step1: start from 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride? Actually we need phenyl-sulfonyl chloride with an amide substituent at para position. Could start from 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride (p-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride) and then acylate the amine with trans-cinnamic acid to give the amide, then sulfonamide formation with p-toluidine. That would be 2 steps: (a) acylate p-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride's amine (which is an aniline) with trans-cinnamic acid to give 4-(cinnamoylamido)benzenesulfonyl chloride. (b) react that sulfonyl chloride with p-toluidine to give target. That's 2 steps total. Leaves: trans-cinnamic acid, p-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride, p-toluidine. All commercially available likely. Need to check price total <9999.

Thus route: final target (mol) children: reaction (sulfonamide formation) template id? Need to find template for sulfonamide formation (N-S bond). Use search for functional_groups_broken maybe "sulfonamide". Let's search.
